question: How much tax does Bob have to pay in 2015?
text: Alice and Bob got married on Feb 3rd, 1992. Alice and Bob have a child, Charlie, born October 9th, 2000. Alice died on July 9th, 2014. From 2004 to 2019, Bob furnished the costs of maintaining the home where he and Charlie lived during that time. In 2015, Bob's gross income was $40059. Bob takes the standard deduction in 2015.
